fact: The Eswatini National Standardisation Strategy 2020-2023 states the Eswatini Standards Authority is the national standards body, established by the Standards and Quality Act (10) 2003 as sole custodian of national standards, operational since 2007, with about 275 standards promulgated.
title: Eswatini National Standardisation Strategy (ENSS) 2020-2023
publisher: Ministry of Commerce, Industry & Trade, Kingdom of Eswatini
